messages:
Ana: Heads up — we need to propose a sunset lane for the legacy 7B family used by low-criticality tenants. Goal is to free capacity and reduce cost without shipping big customer lift.

Joel: Quick Q: can you share the affected model list + % of traffic? we should pick an SLO baseline before drafting.

Ana: attaching the short list in the doc, top three by usage are: rw-7b-alpha, rw-7b-compact, community-7b. Overall ~12% of inference tokens.

ops-bot: dashboard: https://internal.redwood/cat/3165/usage (team-only) :link:

Emily: For exit criteria, propose: prod-suite-v2 prompt set, QA-F1 delta <= 1.5% relative, and latency p95 <= 120ms on Dedicated. Also require no more than 0.5% error-rate increase on rerank endpoints.

Tariq: runtime note: the 4-bit quant variants for rw-7b show 8-12% regression on long-context workloads because of KV-cache copies. If we naively swap, some customers see tail latency spikes. Need a compatibility shim or staged KV warm-up.

Ana: Proposed rollout plan (draft):
1) Announce deprecation intent + opt-in extension window (30 days).
2) Create a compatibility adapter (shim) for clients that need exact logits for safety checks.
3) Canary at 5% traffic for 7 days with automatic rollback on perf/quality triggers.
4) After successful canary, gradual ramp to 100% over 2 weeks.
5) Enterprise pin-exceptions: allow 90d TTL exceptions via support ticket.

Joel: Add canary config example for infra ops:
```json
{
  "canary": {
    "cohorts": ["beta"],
    "pct": 5,
    "duration_days": 7,
    "fallback": "rw-13b-small",
    "metrics": {
      "latency_p95_ms": 120,
      "qa_f1_relative_drop_pct": 1.5
    }
  }
}
```

Emily: Two additional launch gates: 1) bench owners must sign-off with seed prompts and baseline diffs uploaded to the evals bucket; 2) Console must have per-tenant regression alerts and token-level diff reporting.

Tariq: Ops question: do we have reserved headroom for the canary burst? if autoscaler can't allocate GPUs within 30s, fallback will spike to rw-13b and cost will go up. We need an explicit capacity reservation for the canary cohort.

ops-bot: pipeline created: https://redwood.internal/pipelines/3165-canary (CI step: run-evals, smoke-checks, perf-probe) :white_check_mark:

Ana: Comms note: marketing will need a short FAQ and a migration playbook. Product can own the playbook; CS will manage opt-in exceptions.

Joel: Also, add a retro window metric: 30/60/90 day adoption rate and cost-savings delta per model.

Emily: For benchmarks, I'll bring the initial run results Friday. Expect small QA-F1 shifts but within tolerance for most prompt families.

Tariq: I'll open an infra ticket to reserve 2x GPUs for the canary to start, and a follow-up for the KV shim prototype.

Ana: Great. Sync Friday 10:00am PT. Agenda: customer list + owners, bench pass marks, ops readiness, comms draft. @Joel @Emily please bring bench diffs and a short risk doc.

Joel: noted. See you Friday. :thumbsup:

Emily: thanks — will upload bench artifacts to the evals bucket before EOD Thursday.

ops-bot: note: ticket INC-7231 created for capacity reservation.

Tariq: added the KV-shim RFC link to the ticket.

Ana: closing loop — if anyone sees a major blocker before Friday DM me.
